title: docs: publish-and-preview's install-local refusals name the manifest id but not manifest.namespace, which PR #34316 now refuses before any write
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5kgF3mo9f7LXuv5hac

Filing gate: ① (docs follow-up owed by landed work: a user-facing page with a named location that will be false by omission once PR #34316 merges).

**Where:** `content/docs/deployment/publish-and-preview.mdx`, the bullet "A collision is the second refusal, not the first" (about lines 94-101 on `origin/main` 2c96e0df). It lists the install door's pre-collision refusal of a malformed `manifest.id` (`400 PLUGIN_MANIFEST_INVALID`, `502` from a catalog snapshot, nothing registered).

**What changes with PR #34316 (Fixes #33922):** the same door now parses `manifest.namespace` through `ManifestSchema.shape.namespace` right after the id, with the same answers (`400 PLUGIN_MANIFEST_INVALID` inline, `502` from a snapshot, nothing registered). An absent `namespace` still installs; `namespace: null` or a non-string value is now refused.

**Ask:** add the namespace beside the id in that bullet, with one conforming and one refused example taken from the declaration (no new rule text; the declaration's own remedy is what the answer carries).

**Business reason:** an admin who installs an inline manifest with a case-variant or malformed namespace reads this page to learn why the install was refused; today the page names only the id, so the 400 looks undocumented.

**Reader who acts:** the docs owner of `content/docs/deployment/**` after PR #34316 merges. It is the PR body's `Skills-docs:` follow-up (L1 6909138595 N1).

**Dedupe:** `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue publish-and-preview namespace` → 11 hits, `is:issue install-local namespace docs` → 134 hits; read the first page of each (open and closed): only #33922 itself names this door's namespace gate, and no card covers this page.
